rationale_one_line: Needle is a research bet (no FFN, only attention, distilled from a frontier model into 26M params), so MANIFESTO carries it; editorial-paper reads as paper-of-record, which is the right register for a 4x ICLR author shipping the artifact, not the pitch.
writing_tone_notes: Calm conviction. No exclamation. The numbers do the lifting. Contractions where natural. Lead with the size collapse, land on the stake-in-the-ground for on-device specialists.
do_rules: Make the 26M figure a hero beat. big_number scene is the visual anchor.
Name what was distilled (Gemini 3.1) and what was distilled into (Simple Attention Network).
Honor the deployment surface. Phones, watches, glasses are the point.
Close on the position, not on the stars. The MANIFESTO ends with a stance.
dont_rules: No version numbers in any copy surface.
No exclamation points, no superlatives, no 'first ever' claims.
No phrase overlap between tweet, why-this-one, and scene copy.
No on-screen mention of YC, no benchmark name dumps, no 'beats X, Y, Z' grocery list. Pick one comparison or none.
